sources.name: Personal Status Law (Royal Decree No. M/73 of 2022)

steps.title: Filing of Family Case
steps.description: A family case relating to marriage, divorce, custody, maintenance, or guardianship is filed before the Personal Status Court through the Najiz portal or court registry.

steps.title: Case Registration and Notification
steps.description: Court registers the case and notifies the opposing party of the claim and hearing schedule.

steps.title: Reconciliation or Mediation (If Applicable)
steps.description: Court may attempt reconciliation or direct parties to mediation before proceeding with adjudication, where applicable.

steps.title: Submission of Responses
steps.description: Respondent submits a response or defence to the claims raised.

steps.title: Hearings and Evidence
steps.description: Court conducts hearings, examines evidence, and hears submissions from both parties.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court issues a judgment or order resolving the family dispute.

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal against judgment as permitted under the Personal Status Law and Civil Procedure Law
Appeal on points of law or procedural review as permitted under Saudi law
